# LinearMap { #timetoalign.LinearMap }

```python
LinearMap(
    scalar=1.0,
    offset=0,
    source_unit=None,
    target_unit=None,
    uid=None,
    name=None,
)
```

Affine transformation: y = scalar * x + offset.

This is the most general linear map, combining scaling and offset.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name   | Type                                                       | Description                              |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|
| scalar | [CoordinateValue](`timetoalign.core.time.CoordinateValue`) | The multiplicative factor (default 1.0). |
| offset | [CoordinateValue](`timetoalign.core.time.CoordinateValue`) | The additive offset (default 0.0).       |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Convert ticks to quarters: y = x / 480
>>> tick_to_quarter = LinearMap(scalar=1/480, source_unit="ticks", target_unit="quarters")
>>> tick_to_quarter(480)
1.0
```

```python
>>> # Temperature conversion: Celsius to Fahrenheit: y = 1.8x + 32
>>> c_to_f = LinearMap(scalar=1.8, offset=32)
>>> c_to_f(0)
32.0
>>> c_to_f(100)
212.0
```

```python
>>> # Inverse map
>>> f_to_c = c_to_f.inverse()
>>> f_to_c(212.0)
100.0
```

### compose_with { #timetoalign.LinearMap.compose_with }

```python
LinearMap.compose_with(other)
```

Compose with another LinearMap: (self then other).

For y1 = a1*x + b1 and y2 = a2*y1 + b2:
y2 = a2*(a1*x + b1) + b2 = (a1*a2)*x + (a2*b1 + b2)

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                             | Description                      | Default    |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------|------------|
| other  | [LinearMap](`timetoalign.maps.linear.LinearMap`) | The map to apply after this one. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                             | Description                                              |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [LinearMap](`timetoalign.maps.linear.LinearMap`) | A new LinearMap equivalent to applying both in sequence. |

### from_dict { #timetoalign.LinearMap.from_dict }


```python

```
